gate.interpretation: An empirical component gate, not an unseen-family guarantee or M2.

alias_audit.interpretation: Finite observations cannot rule out an unobserved local exception; the same answer is necessarily wrong in at least one compatible world.

costs.boundary: Includes prefix reconstruction, fitting, calibration, scoring and bootstrap. Excludes process startup, later replay/audit and research. Final outcomes never train any control; teaching outcomes are extra learned-guard cost.
